name: Tithing Hike
description: Orzhova's raised tithes to thirty percent, which sparks rioting that ends with a settlement at eighteen percent.

timeline.summary: Miri returns to work after the tithing revolt ends at eighteen percent and presents her father with a secret enchanted money tree.
